subject: Timeboxed MAP & sequencing for Clearwater pilot: MSA/DPA/order-form dependencies
messages:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@clearwaterhealth.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwaterhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-22T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: Pilot MAP and contract sequencing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Clearwater is excited to run the two-week pilot with Redwood — we'd like to lock down a mutual action plan and make sure procurement/legal sequencing is clear before we start.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Can you share a timeboxed MAP with milestones (pilot start, acceptance criteria, invoicing, and go/no-go)?
- What dependencies do you expect between the MSA/DPA and the order form? In other words, can we sign the order form to start the pilot while MSA redlines are in flight?
- Any required artifacts (SLA language, SOC2 evidence, data retention/custody notes) we should include for procurement?

We have our legal and procurement stakeholders on copy. Would like to get a one-page sequencing plan and a spreadsheet-based MAP by end of week if possible.

Best,
Maria Lopez
Director, Strategic Programs
Clearwater Health

Subject: Re: Kickoff: Pilot MAP and contract sequencing

Maria — thanks for the clear asks. Attaching a first-pass timeboxed MAP (spreadsheet) and a short sequencing note. Topline answers up front:

- Pilot can start under a temporary order form (trial order) while MSA/DPA redlines proceed, provided Clearwater accepts the pilot acceptance criteria and we agree on data handling terms in principle.
- We recommend signing a one-page trial order that references the MSA/DPA by version but does not condition the pilot start on fully executed MSA; final entitlements will be capped until MSA execution.
- MSA/DPA redlines that affect data residency or logging will be treated as blockers for production, not pilot.

Next steps proposed: 1) Review attached MAP, 2) 30-min sequencing call with procurement/legal tomorrow, 3) Target pilot start 2026-09-08 (2-week run).

I've attached: Clearwater_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP with owners and gating), MSA_sequencing_note.txt (short), and flagged two clauses in MSA_redlines_v2.docx we expect to iterate.

Thanks — 
Soogin Lee

Thanks — quick note from legal/ops on sequencing and gating.

Key sequencing items (rough priority):
1) Trial order (signed) -> enables pilot provisioning and billing hold. Order form should include trial duration, seat/usage caps, and acceptance criteria.
2) MSA execution -> required for production use, long-term indemnities, warranty language.
3) DPA execution or an interim data addendum -> required if pilot will process PHI/regulated data. For low-risk test data, we can use a data-handling statement until DPA is complete.

Blockers:
- Any changes that materially broaden data access or retention will pause production onramp.
- SOC2 evidence is available; if you require an on-site audit, that will extend timeline.

Suggested acceptance gating for the MAP spreadsheet:
- Pilot readiness: provisioning complete, smoke tests pass (3 checks)
- Acceptance: functional baseline (3 flows), latency/throughput within agreed SLOs, sample data wipe validated
- Procurement: PO or signed order form by acceptance cutover

DocuSign timeline: we can route the trial order for signature in 24 hours once legal confirms final language; MSA redline turnaround target = 5-7 business days depending on the extent of changes.

On the attachment: see MSA_redlines_v2.docx for two suggested edits (Section 8.2 data access; Section 11.4 limitation of liability). Happy to walk through line-by-line in the sequencing call.

-Karthik
Head of Sales Operations (contracts liaison)
Redwood Inference

Hi Maria — looping in a practical timeline from the customer success side. Quoting Soojin below for context:

> Soojin: "Target pilot start 2026-09-08 (2-week run)."

If Clearwater is comfortable with a trial order signature this coming week, CS can provision a sandbox and pre-load test vectors to accelerate validation. Proposed tactical lanes:
- Week 0 (signing): Order form signed and sandbox provisioned (CS owner: Vanessa)
- Week 1 (validation): smoke tests + acceptance checklist run (owner: Clearwater + CS)
- Week 2 (evaluation): metric collection, sample prompts, and performance review (owner: CS + product)
- Post-pilot: PO for staged rollout or extended pilot; MSA to be finalized for production.

I also attached a short acceptance checklist populated with the three essential functional tests we use. If procurement needs an invoice rather than PO for trial, let us know and we'll adjust.

-Vanessa Ortiz

If those two items look good, Maria here will coordinate internal signatures and we can proceed with the sequencing call tomorrow at 11am PT.
